subject: FinBridge VM evidence handshake and DocuSign for attestation
messages:
From: Sarah Li <sarah.li@finbridge.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com
Cc: security@finbridge.com
Date: Sun, 02 Nov 2025 08:23:00 -0800
Subject: Quarterly VM evidence & expedited CVE attestation (CVE-2025-3467)

Hi Jonas,

We're preparing for FinBridge's SOC 2 audit and need Redwood's vulnerability management evidence for the current quarter. Specifically:  

- A machine-readable index of scans performed in 2025 Q4 (authenticated web, internal network, container image scans) with timestamps and owning team. CSV is preferred.
- An attestation that CVE-2025-3467 (kernel privilege escalation identified in our environment) is on your remediation plan with target closure and any temporary compensating controls. We need an SLA commitment for "critical" vulnerabilities and an expedited remediation promise for this CVE (FinBridge defines critical as CVSS >= 9.0).
- A short paragraph (2–3 sentences) we can provide to our external SOC 2 auditor that maps Redwood's VM cadence to the SOC control objectives (monitoring, change management).

Target timeline: can you get the CSV and the attestation to us by Thursday 2025-11-12? If you can provide a DocuSign-ready attestation PDF, that would speed things up.

Thanks,
Sarah Li
Security Program Manager, FinBridge
security@finbridge.com

P.S. If you need to loop in an engineering contact on remediation timelines, please include them in the thread.

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Li <sarah.li@finbridge.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 02 Nov 2025 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quarterly VM evidence & expedited CVE attestation (CVE-2025-3467)

Hi Sarah — thanks for the clear ask. We're on it. Quick summary of what we'll provide and next steps:  

1) Deliverables by 2025-11-12:
   - vm-scan-index-2025Q4.csv (machine-readable scan index) — attached here as a preliminary export.
   - Draft attestation PDF for CVE-2025-3467 (we'll prepare a DocuSign-ready copy and send the link).
   - A 2–3 sentence auditor-friendly mapping paragraph.

2) Questions:  
   - For the attestation, do you need a fully signed declaration from our CEO, or is Director-level (Kimberly/Director, Security Assurance) acceptable for your SOC auditor?
   - Do you want historical remediation evidence for the last 90 days for regressions related to kernel CVEs, or just the planned closure timeline for this CVE?

Kimberly, Mateo — can you confirm the closure SLA and attach the closure log for CVE-2025-3467? I'll forward the DocuSign envelope once we have the language.

Attached: vm-scan-index-2025Q4.csv (prelim).

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Head of Customer Security
Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com

--
Attachment: vm-scan-index-2025Q4.csv (preliminary export)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Li <sarah.li@finbridge.com>, jonas.weber@redwood.com
Cc: mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 03 Nov 2025 09:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quarterly VM evidence & expedited CVE attestation (CVE-2025-3467)

Hi Sarah / team,

Thanks for flagging this. A few concrete points from engineering/security ops:  

- Scan cadence: authenticated internal host scan weekly (Nightly full authenticated scan for infra tagged "prod"), external authenticated web scan weekly, container image scans on CI on every image build, and monthly agentless discovery sweeps.

- Evidence: We are attaching the final scan index (vm-scan-index-2025Q4.csv) which includes columns: scan_id, scanner_type, target_scope, start_time (UTC), end_time (UTC), findings_count, assigned_owner. For your auditors we'll include a CSV row per scan and a referential mapping to our ticketing system.

- SLA / Remediation commitments (Redwood public posture for FinBridge):
   * Critical (CVSS >= 9.0): target remediation <= 14 calendar days from triage with 24/7 escalation for exploit-in-the-wild.
   * High (7.0–8.9): target remediation <= 30 calendar days.
   * Medium (4.0–6.9): target remediation <= 90 calendar days.
   * Low (<4.0): scheduled in maintenance cadence; mitigations applied as needed.

- CVE-2025-3467 status: detected in a subset of customer infra images running older host kernels. Current action items:
   1) Hotfix kernel patches identified and tested by Infrastructure on 2025-11-01.
   2) Staged rollout to dedicated-host customers completed for 60% of affected hosts on 2025-11-02.
   3) Remaining hosts scheduled for phased patching; target full remediation for Redwood-managed hosts by 2025-12-12 (we will prioritize single-tenant/dedicated customers earlier).

Attached: cve-closure-log-202512.pdf (evidence snapshot + patch rollout notes).

For the attestation language, here's a short paragraph you can share with your auditor:  

"Redwood Inference maintains a continuous vulnerability management program with automated and authenticated scanning across our infrastructure, container images, and external endpoints. Scan results are triaged by our Security team with documented SLAs for remediation by severity; we maintain audit-ready scan indices and ticketed remediation records that map to SOC 2 control objectives for system monitoring and change management."

If CEO-level signature is required, we can route the DocuSign to the exec team — otherwise I can sign as Director, Security Assurance.

Kimberly Park
Director, Security Assurance
Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com

--
Attachment: cve-closure-log-202512.pdf

From: Sarah Li <sarah.li@finbridge.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com
Cc: security@finbridge.com
Date: Wed, 05 Nov 2025 10:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quarterly VM evidence & expedited CVE attestation (CVE-2025-3467)

Jonas / Kimberly — this is great, thanks for the quick turnaround and the clear SLA language. A few quick items to close out on our side:  

- The auditor is fine with Director-level signature for the attestation; CEO signature is not required.
- Please send the DocuSign envelope with the final attestation PDF; we'll countersign and return within 48 hours of receipt.
- The 2–3 sentence paragraph you provided looks good; we'll include it in the SOC 2 evidence bundle. Can you also paste that same paragraph into the DocuSign body (auditors prefer the text in the signed document)?

If you can get the DocuSign link today or tomorrow, that would be ideal. Once signed, please also upload the signed copy to the shared Drive link: https://drive.google.com/finbridge/soc2-evidence — I'll confirm with the auditor.

Thanks again — appreciate the prioritization on CVE-2025-3467.

Regards,
Sarah Li
Security Program Manager, FinBridge
